theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The dominant narrative is Oil & Gas, eligible under the validated absolute-trend gate, with the highest durability_bar (0.71), high breadth (0.929), and one_narrative concentration (weight 0.25). The trend discipline here has historically helped control drawdown on this market (gate_helps=true), so retaining exposure to the leader is a risk-controlled lean. Crowding (true, z=1.19) is a size-down caution only, never a fade.
evidence: durability_bar 0.71 is highest among eligible themes
breadth 0.929 indicates broad participation within the theme
gate_helps=true — trend gate validated for drawdown control
theses.dissent: Crowding_z 1.19 and 'crowded=true' plus one_narrative concentration means this theme is extended; if attention inflows mark a local top, crude-producer leadership can reverse fast on a macro shock (unscheduled macro share is 0.75).

falsifier.text: XEG.TO closes below its own 20-day moving average and lags the S&P/TSX by 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks (ZEB.TO) are the only other eligible theme with a genuine trend tag (hurst_tag=trend), mid-pack positive score (0.635), decent durability_bar (0.63), and healthy breadth (0.429) that is NOT crowded (z=0.15). This is a secondary trend-continuation lean that diversifies away from the one-narrative energy concentration while still honouring the absolute-trend gate.
evidence: rotation.frac 0.38 = narrowing, so only a handful of themes hold trend
theses.dissent: Banks are a crowded macro trade globally and sensitive to rate-cut disappointment; score is far below the leader (0.635 vs 1.91), so it may simply be a weak secondary trend that stalls if credit or housing turns.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO gives up all gains since as_of and underperforms XEG.TO by more than 3% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Pipelines & Midstream
theses.thesis: Pipelines & Midstream is eligible and trending (hurst_tag=trend, durability_bar 0.71 same as leader, breadth 0.5), but it is unscorable (no ETF proxy) and only modestly crowded (z=0.58). I name it as a lean only because it is the same energy complex policy-exposed cohort — a direction, not a call to size, and with no scorable proxy it is conviction low.
theses.dissent: Unscorable and low score — no clean way to express or grade it, and midstream is sensitive to pipeline tariff/political risk (unscheduled macro share 0.75).
